listing.name: Sunrider
listing.summary: Adds a story-driven quest mod centered on the Sunrider and its crew, featuring new ships, dialogue, and interactions with multiple factions and mods.

description:
A quest-focused mod based on the game of the same name. The ships, wings, weapons, soundtack and sound effects are also from there.

Note: No money was involved in the making of this, especially because I cannot afford to commission anyone to make or improve any .png in the mod.

Cera's experimental assault carrier, the

Sunrider

has mysteriously shown up in the Persean Sector, as well as her 7 Ryders, but not alone;

allied and enemy ships

are also here and nobody knows

why

.

If you're concerned about copyright: part of Love in Space inc. staff is aware of the existence of this mod and is fine with it!

Safe to add to ongoing saves, but will break saves if updated from 0.7.x to 0.8.x

Warning:

The mod's quests depend on vanilla content; meaning that it is incompatible with anything that removes a faction or location such as some random sector settings, causing the quests to not work properly.

Since the way the base game handles bgm changes mid dialog only through hard-coded methods, do NOT skip dialogues too fast because it will result in an audio bug that can only be fixed by reloading a save from main menu or closing and reopening the game. (Ignore this if you play with music off)

Versions will be 0.x.y until all quests, ships and sprites are at their final. The second number is the amount of *main story* and *side* content added, not how close the mod is from being done. The third number is the amount of patches since the lastest quest/major content addition.

Known issues:

If Jinta Suzuki tells you that the derelict is in an inhabited system (hidden markets do not count), it will not spawn.

Engaging Yoshio or 'UtSE' fleets in hyperspace will softlock their quests.

Current main story quests in chronological order:

SpoilerFirst Arrival: about 270 days after game start, cannot trigger in Pirate/Pather markets.

Help Ava Crescentia recover the titular ship.

Nightmare Breakdown: 30 days after First Arrival, cannot trigger on player colonies.

Dock anywhere and talk to Ava on intel screen.

Origins: 120 days after First Arrival, cannot trigger on Player or Tri-Tachyon markets.

Take the Sunrider to someone that can recover its memory data. Eligible people appear on intel screen. Having

PAGSM

adds an extra option depending on your progress with Yunris Kween. Having Sephira Conclave adds another extra option depending on your progress with Gemie.

Son of Iniquity: 30 days after Origins, try not to start it in Pirate/Pather/ARS bases.

Uncover Ava's early days in the sector.

Vows of the Cosmos: 30 days after Son of iniquity, requires Nightmare Breakdown completed and Pilgrim's Path in progress

or

completed. Can only start in colonies with Luddic Majority condition or a shrine, except Diktat and Path.

Help an engaged couple of luddic pilgrims.

Note: If you're a mod author with an important recruitable character and would like them to participate in the party like Ava/Jill/Dawn, hit me up!

Ryuvian Showdown: Accepted during Vows of the Cosmos.

Find and destroy a superboss fleet.

[close]

Side content:

SpoilerUnder the Sharr's Eyes: 730 days after game start, A102 nebula exists.

Take a job that turns into chaos.

Rejuvenescence: May occur during Son of Iniquity if condition (I will not spoil) is met.

Save and recruit the Prototype.

Chat: After Nightmare Breakdown is cleared, you can chat with Ava. Every main story quest cleared after will unlock new dialogs there, and they may change based on your status in the sector.

Chatting with Celia will be unlocked with her first four hullmods, as well as a special item required to install other, 0-OP cost hullmods...[close]

Quest roadmap (subject to change):

SpoilerDead Star Whiteout (involves luddic path)

Lost Brilliance (involves abyss)

Mr. Y (involves persean league)

Last Pillar's Vengeance (involves diktat)

Bending Reality (final?)

Maybe:

Hope of the Cosmos (luddic couple)

Long Live the Ancient King (doomed)[close]

The stars of the show:

SpoilerDid you skip the message at the top of the thread? It's important, you know... and the links to the images are on the blue words. You didn't? Cool, carry on.[close]

Other ships:

SpoilerSee above, mate.[close]

Other ryders:

SpoilerUp there![close]

Strenghts: Major ballistic focus;

Ballistic projectiles are faster than average;

High frontal firepower;

Many ships have built-in energy and/or missile weapons;

All ships and Ryders with shields have 360º omni shield;

All ships have at least one vanilla hullmod built-in, in addition to Fallen Outsider, which gives corona/storm damage immunity.

Weakenesses: Fallen Outsider also increases monthly supply costs;

All energy (mount and damage) weapons are built-in;

All beam weapons are built-in, face foward, fire like Phase/Tachyon Lance and cannot turn (except those used by ryders).

With one exception, all missile weapons are built-in and with no exceptions, all missiles deal High-Explosive damage;

Fragmentation weapons and phase ships are inexistent;

Some ships have clustered weapons mounts, making high damage hits disable a lot of them at once.

Crossmod interactions:

Spoiler

Nexerelin

:

"Fallen Outsider" faction start has the ships and 'craft' Ryders gathered together.

PAGSM

:

Yunris Kween can help you clear Origins quest with at least 30 rep (dialog is different and cost is nullified if Iapetus 20000 was given);

Celia's skill is boosted if piloting one of the three mechs in the mod.

Sephira Conclave:

Gemie can help you clear Origins quest with at least 30 rep, and will unlock another one-time interaction between her and Ava;

Jill can participate in Vows of the Cosmos if she is in your fleet and conditions are met;

Celia's skill is boosted if piloting the mod's only mech.

Special Hullmod Upgrades

:

Installing a Biofactory Embryo in the titular ship doubles the "Fleet Hospital" effect.

Installing a Coronal Hypershunt in the titular ship triggers a "Flux Discharge" on the location it warps to.

Arma Armatura

:

Frigate version of: PACT Mook, PACT Bomber, PACT Elite, Pirate Grunt, Pirate Bomber and Alliance Trooper: will have 'Strikecraft' hullmod and will deploy from carriers instead of bottom of the screen;

Sunrider, Alliance Carrier (not the modules) and PACT Carrier: will have 'Specialized Service Bays' hullmod;

Dawn Given-to-god can participate in Vows of the Cosmos if she is in your fleet and conditions are met;

Celia's skill is boosted if piloting one of the various mechs in the mod.

If both SHU and ArmaA are installed, the former's AI core boost to Strikecraft will work on frigate-sized Ryders.

Secrets of the Frontier

:

If you do see it, how unfortunate...[close]

Credits:

Love in Space inc. for the ship and mech models and for approving the existence of this mod.

Histidine for making the entire coding and improving the written story script.

Sincronic for all the polishing on ship sprites.

Mayu and WMGreywind for letting me borrow a few codes.

Requirements:

MagicLib

and

LazyLib

Download

0.8.5 patch:

Removed faction and custom nexerelin start for now.

These changes apply only to frigate version of Ryders, not fighters.

Pirate Bomber:

Added Advanced Turret Gyros built-in.

PACT Bomber:

Added Advanced Optics built-in.

Alliance Trooper:

Added ITU built-in.

Pirate Grunt:

Added IPDAI built-in.

PACT Mook:

Added Unstable Injector built-in.

0.8.4 patch:

Added a few more ArmaA hulls to Celia's skill list.

PACT Saviors damage reduced from 225 to 180 (the fact it dealt more damage per hit than capital version shouldn't be, right?);

Flux per shot reduced from 210 to 160.

Fixed? Vows of the Cosmos not being available.

Added Nexerelin start: "Fallen Outsider" faction, spawns as free with PACT/Alliance ships and 'craft' Ryders.

0.8.3 patch:

fixed a fatal typo

added a version checker

0.8.2 patch:

added another layer of failsafe to make sure no quests are repeatable (even though they definitely should already...)

Alliance Capital Saviors flux per shot increased from 400 to 450 (1/1 damage/flux)

0.8.1 patch: (Save-compatible with 0.8, but NOT with any 0.7.x versions)

Fixed a small visual bug in a rare dialog (with the number of times where multiple options are displayed but lead to the same outcome in vanilla game, it's shocking and weird as hell that you need to make one row for each in rules... gdi);

Added a new condition to save the Prototype, somewhat related to the existing one. If either or both are fulfilled, she survives (i will not add more details or spoil it);

Celia Ashada can participate in Vows of the Cosmos if she's in your fleet (actually, that was available on the big update, but i forgor to point it out)

Evolved Ceran Saviors flux per shot reduced from 550 to 480;

One of new hullmods had its effect nerfed and drawback increased (spoiler, too early to spill);

Fixed Azure Amplification not affecting PACT Elite's laser.

0.8 update (NOT save-compatible with previous versions)

There was so much content added to the rules.csv that it went from 634 to 905 rows!

Chat

Ava Crescentia:

Added a new interaction:

After completing Nightmare Breakdown, you can chat with her on contacts list (intel screen) if she's in your fleet.

After completing each main story quest, a one-time event will occur when calling her and they will have a cooldown of 30 days between one-another.

There is also a dialog that is mutually exclusive with one of Celia's events

Dawn Given-to-god (

Arma Armatura

) will side with Ava if something happens (Shoi's idea);

Sierra (

Secrets of the Frontier

) will side with Ava if something happens.

Celia Ashada:

Wait times for her recruitment steps and first four hullmod gifts have been changed to multiplicatives of 12, overall slightly longer.

Ryuvian Showdown briefing (before Vows of the Cosmos completes) will have slight differences if Celia is also recruited.

Added a new interaction.

After receiving the 4 first hullmods from her, you can
